trivia night thursday, we are winning this time 🔥

ok I have thoughts about the trip. first, the cabin was amazing and I would go back tomorrow. second, whoever planned the 6am hike owes all of us breakfast for a year. third, the lake was freezing but worth it. fourth, the board game night got way too competitive and I still think the rules were wrong. fifth, the drive home playlist was elite. sixth, we need to book the next one before everyone gets busy again. also thank you all, honestly the best weekend in ages and I mean that
I am never doing a 6am hike again
